root_cause.text: The unsafe direct overwrite of a 512-bit PASID table entry (via structure assignment `*pte = new_pte`) while the entry is active (Present bit set) can cause a torn read by the IOMMU hardware, which fetches the entry in multiple 128-bit chunks, leading to an inconsistent state.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Because the hardware may fetch the 512-bit PASID entry in multiple 128-bit chunks, updating the entire entry while it is active (Present bit set) risks a 'torn' read." The patch removes all `intel_pasid_replace_*` helper functions and replaces them with a "clear-then-update" flow that tears down the old entry before setting up the new one, as shown in the diff changes to domain setup functions.
